findings.detail: tools/trigger2_trusted_hyperposition_pilot_generator_v1.py build_subjects() output alone is NOT a valid adjudicate() row -- it lacks source_binding, generation_case_id_evaluator_only, generation_receipt_evaluator_only and other _evaluator_only-suffixed fields the gates require. The correct wrapping recipe exists only inside tests/test_trigger2_genesis_history_producer_authority_v1.py (_authorized_generation_fields, _hist_chain_row helpers) -- there is no production-facing row-assembly tool, only a test-only one.
findings.implication: Any future gold-pilot generation work must either promote this test helper into a real tools/ row-assembly utility, or hand-build the equivalent wrapping -- this is nontrivial (discriminator receipts, independence derivation, u_state replay, resolution/elimination sets).

findings.detail: Using the exact known-good row from _hist_chain_row(), GENERATION_PROVENANCE now passes (confirms the Phase 3 closure from earlier this campaign works correctly against a real row, not just its own unit tests). But A02_DISCRIMINATOR_PRODUCER_AUTH fails with 6 failures, most tellingly A02_V1_REQUIRES_EMPTY_HISTORY_BOUNDED_PILOT -- the A02 gate is structurally scoped to empty-history (DB_MATCH-style) rows only and has never been extended to accept nonempty-history (HIST_CHAIN) rows.
findings.implication: The two authorized generator cases are NOT interchangeable through the full pipeline: HIST_CHAIN can currently only ever fail at A02, regardless of any other gate's state. This is a real, previously-undiscovered architectural gap, distinct from everything closed so far this session.

findings.detail: Time-boxed as a single fork task; did not hand-construct the equivalent full-row wrapper for T2_GP_PILOT_DB_MATCH_V1 (empty-history case, which A02 v1 says it wants) to test whether that case can pass the complete v4 chain end-to-end. findings.detail: TRIGGER2_TRUSTED_SYNTHETIC_GENERATOR_AUTHORITY_V1.json explicitly states its purpose is generation-provenance PROPERTY TESTING with two fixed deterministic synthetic cases (DB_MATCH, HIST_CHAIN) -- not a mechanism for producing diverse content across the target training categories (abstention, DB-vs-simulation, ClayCode syntax, hard negatives, etc.) described in the entity's own 256-row target plan. Both authorized rows are also hardcoded training_eligible=false in their own generator output.
findings.implication: Even once the A02/empty-history mismatch is resolved, getting a REAL diverse gold-pilot batch (multiple categories, multiple genuine families, hard negatives) requires either authorizing new generator cases in TRIGGER2_TRUSTED_SYNTHETIC_GENERATOR_AUTHORITY_V1.json (a deliberate, careful authority-expansion decision, not something to do casually mid-pilot-attempt) or building a new, still-nonexistent content-generation capability. This is the deepest, most fundamental remaining gap -- deeper than the P0/P1 items closed so far this session.

recommended_next_step: Hand-build (or promote from the test helper) a complete DB_MATCH row wrapper and test it through the full v4 chain -- if that also fails, the A02 gate itself needs inspection for what an empty-history row must exactly look like.
